sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
Spin the Wheel's core gameplay mechanics are simple yet effective. The game is all about spinning the wheel to accumulate points, and your points will always remain in play. But what makes the game so challenging is the way the points are distributed. Each section of the wheel has a different point value, and the more sections you fill, the more points you'll earn. But, of course, there's a catch. If you fill a section with a high point value, you'll earn more points, but you'll also increase the number of points you need to fill the next section. It's a delicate balance that requires strategy and skill to master.

As you play the game, you'll also notice that there are power-ups scattered throughout the wheel. These power-ups can be used to boost your points, fill in sections, or even spin the wheel for you. But be careful, because some power-ups can also have negative effects. For example, the 'steal' power-up will steal points from another player, while the 'freeze' power-up will freeze the wheel for a set amount of time. It's a great way to mix things up and keep the game exciting.
